title: Building an AHB-Lite Protocol Monitor & Checker
description: Build a passive pipelined AHB-Lite monitor and separate protocol checks from environment watchdog policy.

steps.title: Reconstruct pipelined transfers
steps.instructions: Complete `ahb_monitor.sv` so address/control and data phases remain correctly paired across wait states.

steps.title: Add protocol assertions
steps.instructions: Complete `ahb_checker.sv` with stability and two-cycle ERROR checks; keep the HREADY timeout labeled as an environment watchdog.

steps.title: Triage the broken scenario
steps.instructions: Run `testbench.sv` in broken mode and identify each failure without treating bounded slave latency as a protocol rule.
